39K likes, 1,228 comments - bollywood on August 1, 2025: "This bizarre and now-iconic image is the visual representation often associated with the "Hakla Shahrukh" meme GIF — a viral internet moment that wasn't actually from Shah Rukh Khan himself. The meme gained traction from a comedic impersonation by a mimicry artist who exaggerated SRK’s signature stammer in dialogues like “main... main... main hoon na”. Over time, this imitation became a catchphrase across roast videos and meme pages, used to mock hesitation, overconfidence, or awkward moments.

The image attached — a distorted, cartoonish parody — is frequently paired with the "Hakla Shahrukh" audio to exaggerate the awkwardness and comic timing. While it has no direct connection to SRK, its exaggerated features and chaotic hairstyle amplify the meme's absurdity, making it a staple in desi meme culture. What started as mimicry turned into a meme phenomenon.
